# FQ-GAP-TENSOR-UNIQUENESS

Bipartite composition and the chosen product-coordinate host are admitted. Outer-product factorization is checked on actual rational coordinates, with universal determinant-zero and fixed identity-coefficient determinant-one kernel statements. This separates a product vector from the stated entangled coefficient array. Neither nonfactorization nor a projector summary proves uniqueness of state/effect tensor products or exclusion of min/max cones.

On the admitted 2x2 rational coefficient host every simple tensor has zero coefficient determinant; [[1,0],[0,1]] has determinant one and is not simple. Native norm multiplication is checked on retained inputs.

Remaining: Formalize state/effect cones, covariance requirements, their min/max comparison and any uniqueness theorem; general tensor selection remains an import.
